lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It goes to the labour board on a Thursday afternoon, in a folder, with four hundred and six names in alphabetical order and a covering note of one paragraph.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nothing happens. The board notes it, files it, and publishes it — because publishing is what a board does with a thing it has decided not to act on, and the publishing is automatic and the acting is not.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Published. That is the whole point and it is the only point. Nobody will read it this year or for two hundred years.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: But it is in the record now, and the record is the only thing on this site that survives to my century.
